lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where a newly sworn-in Council takes up second reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — land use amendments covering historic review and landscaping standards that bring Telluride into line with state wildfire law. Also Tuesday, the Telluride Housing Authority is working through a real policy question about primary residency for dependents in multi-custodial households, the kind of edge case that matters a lot to the families it affects. On the weekend side, the San Miguel Basin Fair is running through Saturday and Sunday with its usual late-night board debriefs, and Shakespeare in the Park opens Friday with 'Henry V.'

notable.stake: Second reading vote on wildfire code changes to land use and landscaping rules.
New policy on primary residency for dependents in split-custody housing situations.
